findings.title: CVE-2026-109593: SonicWall GMS unauthenticated file read (CWE-636)
findings.summary_md: OffSeq Threat Radar lists CVE-2026-109593 for SonicWall GMS 9.5.2 and earlier, describing an unauthenticated network attacker able to read internal GMS files. The entry carries a CVSS v3.1 score of 9.1 and references the vendor advisory at psirt.global.sonicwall.com/vuln-detail/SNWLID-2026-0019. Published 2026-11-03.

findings.title: SonicWall vendor advisory SNWLID-2026-0019 (linked CVE-2026-109593 / CVE-2026-109594)
findings.summary_md: The SonicWall PSIRT advisory page for SNWLID-2026-0019 is referenced across CVE listings and search results dated 2026-11-03. It covers both an unauthenticated file-read flaw (CVE-2026-109593, CVSS 9.1) and an SQL injection (CVE-2026-109594, CVSS 6.8) in GMS 9.5.2 and earlier. The page requires JavaScript rendering; the date is confirmed by linked database entries.

findings.title: CVE-2026-109593 entry at cve.threatint.com referencing advisory
findings.summary_md: ThreatInt CVE entry for CVE-2026-109593 links to the SonicWall advisory SNWLID-2026-0019. The snippet confirms the affected versions are GMS 9.5.2 and earlier and that an unauthenticated attacker may read internal files. Search result shows a Nov 3, 2026 publication reference.
